checks.text: With no image loaded, the drop zone shows the text "Drop an image or click to browse".

After dropping a 512x512 PNG named "logo.png", the preview area shows the text "logo.png" and the list of generated sizes shows the items "16x16", "32x32", "48x48", "64x64", "128x128", "192x192", "256x256" and "512x512".
Selecting "Square" in the select labelled "Crop shape" and clicking the button "Apply" updates the preview and the list still shows all eight size items.
Selecting "Circle" in the select labelled "Crop shape" and clicking the button "Apply" updates the preview; the list still shows all eight size items.
Setting the slider labelled "Quality" to "80" and clicking the button "Apply" updates the preview; the list still shows all eight size items.
Clicking the button "Download all" triggers a download of a file named "favicons.zip".
Clicking the button "Download 16x16" triggers a download of a file named "favicon-16x16.png".
Reload keeps the generated set: after dropping "logo.png" and reloading, the preview area still shows "logo.png" and the list still shows the item "16x16".
